payload.blocks: Phase 1 (fgos authority locate), and through it phases 5, 7 and 11.
payload.headline: Add packages/host-runtime/rust/src/catalog.rs to the authority-doors footprint so locate passes caller admission?

parts.cause: The final unit's report (unit-run-1795408708927-8c256f08, plans/261121-2110-component-authority-doors/reports/unit-261123-0819-p01-result.md 'Final round') applied one OperationDescriptor row plus the CATALOG length bump (53 to 54) in that file's own test, temporarily. With it, cargo test -p fgos --test authority and cargo test -p fgos-host-runtime both passed. The worker then reverted it, because it was out of scope.

options.cost: One footprint line, about 15 lines of Rust.
options.does: Adds packages/host-runtime/rust/src/catalog.rs to the plan footprint (phases 1 and 5). The next unit adds the one authority.locate row and the length bump. Phase 5 adds authority.declare the same way.
options.gain: The verb passes admission, and phase 1 lands right after review.
options.harm: catalog.rs is a shared host file, so a plan that also lists it would wait at admission.
options.label: A. Add catalog.rs to the footprint

options.cost: None now, plus a follow-up item.
options.does: Lands the crate and wiring now, and moves the catalog row to a later phase or plan.
options.harm: The verb is unusable and its test is red, so npm/cargo test fails and the DoD is not met.
options.label: B. Land phase 1 without a working verb

parts.recommendation: A: it is the same registration pattern as main.rs, it was proven by a temporary patch, and it is the last gap.

scope.allows: Adding packages/host-runtime/rust/src/catalog.rs to the plan footprint (phases 1 and 5), only for the authority.locate and authority.declare operation rows and that file's own count test.
scope.forbids: Any other change to catalog.rs or to the host runtime.

parts.what: Phase 1 is complete apart from one row. The verb is registered in main.rs and the registry, contracts, drift test, crate tests and cargo fmt are green. The verb test is still refused with 'operation authority.locate not found in catalog', because caller admission reads CATALOG in packages/host-runtime/rust/src/catalog.rs, which is outside the footprint.
